patterns: Overwhelmingly one question: in which case was the basic structure doctrine propounded? Kesavananda Bharati (1973); distractors Golaknath, Sajjan Singh, Shankari Prasad, A.K. Gopalan.
Source/nature items: doctrine comes from judicial interpretation, not the Constitution text or a statute (APPSC G1 2024 trap: 'incorporated by an Act').
Definition shape: basic structure = what cannot be amended under Art. 368; core features cannot be altered by Parliament.
Coelho case -> Ninth Schedule is a recurring one-liner.
App goes deeper (bench splits, Minerva clauses, element-to-case pairs, 129th Bill debate) with many multi-statement items; PYQs stay at case-name level.
